create_SO2_from_angle: create an SO2 rotation group element from a theta angle tensor
build_SO2_exp_map: build an SO2 element from a tangent vector using the exponential map
rotate_point_with_SO2: rotate a 2D point by an SO2 rotation and optionally compute jacobians
convert_SO2_to_matrix: convert an SO2 rotation element to its 2x2 rotation matrix representation
compute_SO2_hat_matrix: compute the skew-symmetric hat matrix from an SO2 tangent vector
